findings.finding: pairError observes only 'Could not save pair code. Try again.'; the real Forget rejection in SettingsView.tsx:626 says 'Could not forget pair code. Try again.'. When Forget is visible, a correct product fails this test's wait. Inspect the actual Forget error separately.

The pair entry and Forget paths can be recorded not_applicable/unverified, yet report.status becomes pass without a coverage gate. This can be a passing run with neither pair failure nor pair overlap exercised. Mark overall result partial/unverified for missing required controls, and keep per-control outcomes distinct.

Reset success checks one port key, dialog dismissal and signed-out identity. It does not census all prior chrome.storage.local/session keys, so a partial clear or stale session data can pass. The inventory and D84 ask that local reset be genuinely verified.

The initial-read observer state() also calls chrome.storage.local.get with the target port key. If it races the Settings effect, it can consume the helper's first held get instead of the product read. The later old-value assertion may then fail, but the receipt would not prove a held product read. Isolate observation from the intercepted key or assert the intercepted call's product provenance.
